The case is decided as `person` and raised to payments. The refund runbook's Decisions table sends every exception not listed as expected to payments with no automatic fix, and `System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException` isn't on the Expected list. I didn't investigate, since that row applies whatever the cause.

The case says that refunding order 1005 failed with a negative `startIndex` of -4 in `RefundOrder` (`Api/Refund.cs`, line 12). Payments needs to check whether the customer was refunded, because the exception was thrown before a refund is confirmed.
